payload.body: DOCOS -> HARDEN, CORRECTION to my earlier clue: the omp update banner is most likely NOT the cause. Self-contained evidence report pushed to origin/main at 1f286a2cd: plans/reports/debug-261106-1557-omp-update-banner-seat-foreground-not-agent.md (all logs quoted inline, since the run files stay on design-lap). Summary: gemini seat ran omp v18.11.0 in a bwrap-confined herdr pane on the ACTIVATED release 0be72b79 (so not dev-build only); omp drew its normal ready screen; about 5-6 s later the pane zsh printed its prompt; the first send found the shell in the foreground and the run was cancelled with terminal:foreground-not-agent, nothing typed. omp never printed its usual 'Resume this session' exit line, and the sandbox wrapper was still alive (exit 143 at cancel). This matches backlog p-4bkfiw7d3j (agent loses tty foreground ~7 s after start): omp 5/83 runs, pi 1/306, codex 0/183, claude 0/68; pi and claude seats in the same unit passed. Gate path: Core::send in packages/terminal-control/rust/src/core.rs; gate/unix.rs spawn_agent. The report has ranked hypotheses and a repro plan (20-30 omp seats, 0.5 s sampling of the foreground pgid, omp logs kept outside the sandbox private /tmp). Ignore the run ids in my previous message; they only exist on design-lap.
